notes:
Inbound PLG signup from indie dev building a lightweight code-assistant web app. Signed up 2026-02-15 via self-serve, grabbed test API key and started smoke tests. App is a browser-based code helper for JS/TS snippets, calling embeddings + chat for context-aware completions. Small team (1 founder + 1 contractor).

Quick facts: started calls Feb 16, ~3k tokens used first week, spike of 40 reqs/day during dev. Latency target: <200ms median for chat UI; throughput needs small (~5-10 rps typical). Cost sensitivity high; wants to keep infra bill <$200/month initially. Prefers open models / quantized variants to control cost; mentioned Llama/Mistral experiments.

Security/compliance: no enterprise SSO yet, just OAuth for product users. Asked about audit logs and data retention - "we need to be able to purge user prompts on demand". Data residency not required.

Quotes from founder: "We like how fast the hosted API spun up - zero infra headaches. Cost is the only real question right now."

Behavior: pure self-serve so far, no AE outreach. Good candidate for automated drip: onboarding tips, batching/caching guide, model/quantization suggestions. Might convert to paid within 1-2 months if billing is simple and cost per request is predictable.

Potential upsell later: Dedicated only if scale grows and steady ARR, otherwise will remain hosted. No immediate security blockers.

Suggested outreach: onboarding email with sample repo (node/deno), cost calculator, and short note on latency tuning (batching vs streaming).
